name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
about: Established in 2017, Dev Accelerator Limited, commonly known as DevX, provides flexible office spaces, including coworking environments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
The company is among the largest flex space operators in Tier-2 markets, offering managed and co-working spaces, along with design & execution (via Neddle & Thread Designs), payroll & facility management, and IT/ITeS services (via Saasjoy Solutions).

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -13.0%
Debtor days have increased from 52.1 to 97.1 days.
